# Microsoft Defender events

Real Microsoft Defender Antivirus events (1116, 1117, 1121 and 5007) as event
XML, from the example logs of
[splunk/security_content](https://github.com/splunk/security_content)
(`data_sources/windows_event_log_defender_*.yml`), Apache License 2.0,
Copyright Splunk Inc. TestOTLPDefenderSamples sends them as the OpenTelemetry
Collector's windowseventlog receiver would.
